layman_headline: Market fear is running high and the candidates on the board are too risky to touch right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is sitting at a Fear score of 27 out of 100, which means most traders are nervous and selling. Bitcoin is barely moving, but the altcoins on our watchlist are either crashing hard with terrible charts, pumping too far too fast, or have almost no data to analyze. None of them offer a clean setup where the potential reward clearly outweighs the risk. In environments like this, the smartest move is often to do nothing and wait for better opportunities.
layman_action: Stay in cash or stablecoins. Do not chase any of the coins that dropped 20-30% — they could easily drop further. Wait for the Fear index to stabilize or for a clear technical bounce with volume confirmation before entering a new trade.
expert_reasoning: Every swing candidate has critical flaws. BTW is up 86% in 7 days — chasing that is textbook FOMO with no RSI or chart data to confirm continuation. KAITO is down 31.5% weekly and 68% from ATH with zero technical data — a falling knife with no visible floor. LDO is down 17.8% weekly and 95.9% from ATH, signaling structural decline, not a bounce setup. 币安人生 has the only chart analysis available and it reads strongly bearish (-1.65 bias) with a bearish engulfing pattern, price below all MAs, and a terrible 0.40x risk/reward ratio. UB and MON are flat with no data. USDG is a stablecoin. Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening trend, BTC dominance at 56.6% crushing alts — this is not the environment to force an alt entry. Per my validated rules, F&G near 25 warrants holding, and the lack of RSI/MACD/funding rate data across nearly all candidates means fewer than three core data sources are functional for most coins.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed could drop below 25, triggering further capitulation in alts
BTC dominance at 56.6% and rising means capital continues flowing out of altcoins
Most swing candidates lack any technical indicators (RSI, MACD, funding rates), making risk assessment unreliable
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for stabilization above 30 or further deterioration below 25
LDO price action around $0.28-0.30 — if it forms a base with rising volume it could become a valid bounce play
BTC dominance trend — a reversal below 55% would signal rotation back into alts
market_context: The crypto market is in a fearful state (F&G 27, worsening trend) with BTC dominance high at 56.6%, crushing altcoin performance. BTC itself is range-bound near $64,800, neither breaking out nor breaking down, while alts are bleeding.
context_banner: Fear dominates the market with no clean alt setups — capital preservation is the correct strategy until conditions improve.
